/* file : UserMapper.xml, id : getUserList */ SELECT U.*, USER_ID AS ID, USER_NM AS USERNAME , (SELECT DTL_CD_NM FROM TB_CODE_DTL D WHERE D.GRP_CD = 'AUTH' AND D.DTL_CD = U.USER_AUTH_CD LIMIT 1) AS AUTH_NM
FROM TB_USER U WHERE U.DEL_YN = 'N'
AND U.${field} LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY USER_SEQ DESC /*||ORDER BY USER_SEQ DESC||*/
/* file : UserMapper.xml, id : existedUserId */ SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM TB_USER U WHERE U.DEL_YN = 'N' AND U.USER_ID = LOWER(#{id})
